name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 27, 2015
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Chaplain Christopher Merris, Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring February to be "American Heart Health Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Issuance of 2015 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds (SA)
C4.
CIP No. 8125 Agua Hedionda Sewer Lift Station and Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer, Reaches VC11B-VC15 - Easement Agreement and Project Agreement for Construction (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an Easement Agreement between Cabrillo Power, LLC and the San Diego Gas & Electric Company.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving the Project Agreement for construction of the Agua Hedionda Sewer Lift Station and Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer.
C5.
City Council Policy 200-04, City Council Meetings (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
CIP No. 8232 Paseo Santa Fe Streetscape Improvements Project Phase 1 - Award of Construction Contract and Purchase Agreements (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2015- , awarding a construction contract to Dick Miller, Inc. for Streetscape Improvements.
2.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving the purchase agreements with Sternberg Lanterns, Inc. and Park Pacific, Inc. for the Streetscape Improvements.
3.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the agreement with Buccola Engineering, Inc. for Design and Engineering Services.
4.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the agreement with GeoSoils, Inc. for Geotechnical Services.
5.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program FY 2014/15.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Bicycle Master Plan (PC19-075) and Implementation Actions, Including General Plan Amendment, Development Code Amendment, and Removal of On-Street Parking (CC)
1.
Open, conduct and close a public hearing to receive testimony.
2.
Adopt the following City Council Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2015- , certifying Addendum No. 2 to the Final Program Environmental Impact Report prepared for the General Plan 2030 Update;
b.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving the Bicycle Master Plan;
(recommended action continued on following page)
c.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving a General Plan Amendment to revise certain language within the Bicycle and Pedestrian Circulation section of the General Plan 2030 Circulation Element, and to remove and replace "Table CE-6 - Priority Bikeway Projects" and "Figure CE-4 - Bikeway Plan"; and
d.
Resolution No. 2015- , authorizing the removal of on-street parking at specified locations.
3.
Introduce and adopt the following Ordinances:
a.
Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 18.54.080 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Bicycle Parking"; and
b.
Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 10.68.100 of the Vista Municipal Code with Respect to Bicycles on Sidewalks."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
